definition.def: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose. You can also say that two people cooperate.
examples: The U.N. had been cooperating with the State Department on a plan to find countries willing to take the refugees.

definition.def: If you cooperate, you do what someone has asked or told you to do.
examples: He agreed to cooperate with the police investigation.

examples.sentence: So you're going to learn how to cooperate as a team in order to plan and conduct this research assignment.
